historical_pattern: Captured prior-history support by season is computed before same-day updates. Excludes noneligible historical pairs. Historical provider publication times are unverified.
current_pattern: Per-event audit plus source manifest and explicit refusals.

contracts.source: ESPN groups=50 six-date window within six hours and pinned hoopR season files
contracts.missing: incomplete manifest, timeout or date/hash mismatch
contracts.fallback: block run, never infer an empty schedule

contracts.input: event identity, home/away team IDs, Pacific time and D-I membership
contracts.source: dated ESPN schedule, verified prior season archive
contracts.missing: unresolved, invalid or conflicting identity or unrecognized affiliation
contracts.transform: no alias guessing or positional default
contracts.fallback: refuse affected fixture; quarantine unreconciled historical inputs

contracts.heads: home_score, away_score, home_margin, all joint-derived products
contracts.source: retained competition and earlier eligible finals
contracts.transform: true neutral; false verified nonneutral; never coerce null to home or neutral
contracts.fallback: refuse target; block ambiguous historical fit

contracts.input: team strength, scoring environment and number of eligible earlier games
contracts.transform: zero-initialized strength/environment for rating assimilation only; retain 50% across seasons
contracts.fallback: refuse insufficient or unresolved team history

contracts.input: mean venue margin and scoring total
contracts.source: training seasons ending 2022 through 2024, official earlier positive decisive final scores
contracts.missing: empty warm or venue population; invalid/absent score

contracts.source: earlier season ending 2025, verified minimum history
contracts.missing: insufficient residuals or empty legal support
contracts.transform: center pairs; round and condition on legal nonnegative unequal scores
contracts.fallback: block fit when residual bank absent, refuse individual event when out of joint support

contracts.input: injuries, lineup, minutes, weather, sportsbook prices
